newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.90 to the dollar on Monday in the kerb market and dealers said the rupee may open stable on Tuesday.
They said profit-taking in dollars, despite short supplies, may keep the rupee stable on Tuesday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.80 percent, from Sunday's close at 4.70 percent.
